comment: Positions are folded rather than clamped at ImageIn.cpp:73-78 through fold_into_range, so a voltage outside the chosen range reads a mirrored copy of the picture. The colour comes out as ten times the byte divided by 256 (lines 92-101), with five volts taken off again in the bipolar setting, so the top of the range is just under the nominal maximum. The load button is tested with a plain equality against 1 at line 58 rather than an edge detector, so the dialogue opens while the button is held. The file filter list is in the source at line 41.
